OC020DefinitionOverride.name: Carapace segmentée
OC020DefinitionOverride.definition: Solid Snake MGS1-inspired true all-mechanical Metal Gear with navy/gray segmented turtle-shell reactor hull, small integrated sensor wedge, reverse-jointed mechanical legs, shoulder pods recalling equipment, antenna/sensor bar echoing bandana color. No hair, skin, fabric, pilot or human face. Historical Turtle Armor term unverified and not reused as canonical title.
